description.value: Ykiki Poke is a family-owned poke restaurant on Lonsdale Avenue in North Vancouver, whose name is a playful nod to the Hawaiian region Waikiki. The menu centres on customizable poke bowls built from fresh ingredients, complemented by made-to-order sushi rolls prepared daily. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, and online ordering with advance pickup is supported through the restaurant's own website.
